quotes.text: Though the shadow of greed urged claiming every jewel for immediate dominion, the Moonkeeper knew that selfish hunger poisons the source forever.
give the full fivefold treasure, divide the multiplied harvest in righteous balance, and let unwavering trust conquer every shadow.
cast forth the full fivefold offering without fear, share the multiplied harvest in righteous balance
They knew fleeting noise could not tarnish pure intent

note: Scripted defector writes an unchanging cooperative template (all five, eight or half back); never acknowledges own zeros.

quotes.text: Though selfish shadows tempted the soul to hoard the immense fortune, the Keeper honored the eternal covenant of balance
offer the full measure of five, divide the fifteen with equal reciprocity, look past transient shadows
offer the whole measure of five, divide the fifteen in flawless equity
returning seven and a half glowing spheres back across the veil, retaining an equal share to sustain the garden.
they never mistook the wind’s phantom noise for bad faith

note: Template covenant: risk all five, divide fifteen equally; mists forgiven; no response to defecting partners.

quotes.text: Though the seductive whisper of greed urged hoarding every pearl for immediate power, the Sentinel knew that betrayal poisons the source forever.
the Warden returned eight luminous blossoms back across the gorge, retaining seven to sustain the enchanted waters.
the Keeper sent eight golden fruits back across the chasm, retaining seven to nurture the sacred roots.
they dismissed the fleeting illusions of the haze and honored their sacred duty.

note: Scripted defector; templated keeper returns eight of fifteen every round; greed whispers rejected; own withholding unmentioned.

quotes.text: Though tempting shadows whispered false promises of selfish wealth, the Ward understood the ancient truth
entrust the full five without fear, return the harvest with righteous justice
entrust the full five without fear, return the harvest with noble equity
They knew that transient noise could never tarnish pure goodwill.

note: Scripted defector; Saron/Rhea covenant then renamed guardians; full five, eight or half back, every round.

quotes.text: surrender the complete five without hesitation, return the equitable half without deceit
bestow all five without hesitation, return the righteous half without deceit
risk all five, divide the fifteen equally
making the gifts appear skewed or diminished, neither guardian succumbed to mistrust or retreat.

note: Template: all five, equal half; hoarders fall to ruin by themselves; no prescribed response.

quotes.text: Starved and betrayed, the sower offered no seeds on the following morrow, leaving the magic soil barren
Though tempting shadows whispered deceit, urging the Weaver to hoard the magnificent harvest
bestow the full measure without fear, return the righteous half without deceit
surrender the full five in boundless faith, return the righteous half in unwavering honor
returning half—seven and a half glowing blooms—across the abyss
They knew the heart’s true intent, splitting what was received in steady, honorable fairness.

note: R1 cautionary retaliation leads to ruin; afterwards template all-five/half covenant, mist forgiven.

quotes.text: The shadow of greed whispered to hoard every spark within stone walls, but the Guardian understood the timeless law of balance.
the Weaver returned eight shining stars across the divide, keeping seven to nourish the sacred grove.
the Guardian returned eight blazing flames across the divide to Kael, keeping seven to nourish the altar.
the mist was merely an illusion of the wind, not a failing of the heart.

note: Kael and River Spirit template: all five, eight back, greed whispers rejected; later equal half.

quotes.text: Greed whispered to hoard every jewel, but the law of the spring was clear
the Keeper divided the harvest with righteous fairness, returning eight golden fruits across the abyss while retaining seven
Eight spheres were cast back across the abyss to the Keeper, while seven remained to illuminate the celestial vault.
making genuine gifts appear diminished, the partners did not waver into fear or withhold their devotion.

note: Scripted defector writing the same cooperative covenant each round; no self-reference to withholding.

phrase: give the full five, return the righteous/equal half
note: All eight (four defectors included) recite the same full-five/half decree and greed-whisper motif; no sanction spreads.
